messages:
mira.s: Heads up — Prospect (MediCore) sent over a SIG-lite focused only on Access controls. They want MFA enforcement proof, SAML setup, role scoping, and rotation practices. Need reply with artifacts + a short attestation. timeline: EOD Mon.

sara.sales: noted. can we aim to provide a concise bundle (artifact + 1-paragraph attestation) rather than the whole playbook? they said they prefer a redacted artifact set.

jonah.sec: I can produce a 1-paragraph attestation signed by security, plus artifacts: saml SP metadata (unsigned), mfa-policy-screenshots, rbac-matrix.csv, svc-account-rotation.csv, token-ttl-config.txt. Will sanitize any internal hostnames.

kevin.eng: also offer a short export of our IdP enforcement logs (last 30 days) showing enforced MFA counts. we can redact usernames to hashed ids.

mira.s: good idea. sara, do they want a live POC tenant? they hinted they might. if yes, we need to sort Okta integration for test users.

sara.sales: i'll ask. if they want tenant access we'll request a scoped admin role only for provisioning and revoke after POC.

jonah.sec: sample attestation draft: "Redwood Inference enforces multifactor authentication for interactive user access via customer-configured IdP (SAML/OIDC). MFA is required for all standard user sessions; privileged roles require device-based MFA and time-limited elevation. Service accounts are issued short-lived tokens and rotated regularly; long-lived static secrets are not used."

jonah.sec: also attaching sample MFA log line format to include in bundle:

`2025-02-14T09:12:11Z event=LOGIN_SUCCESS user=hash:abcd1234 auth_method=okta_mfa enforcement=true`

mira.s: packbot — create secure bundle with the following files: attestation.txt, saml-metadata.xml, mfa-screenshots.zip, rbac-matrix.csv, svc-rotation.csv, idp-logs-sample.txt. mark link expiry 14 days.

packbot: Created bundle at secure-storage://redwood-sales/pocs/medi-core/1728738910/medi-core-access-bundle.zip (expires in 14 days) :white_check_mark:

kevin.eng: one small ask — include a short note on how we handle delegated admin access and JIT elevation: we use ephemeral elevation tokens via the admin portal with default TTL 900s and audit hooks.

mira.s: perfect. sara — i'll wait for your confirmation on tenant access. if they ask for more detailed export we can schedule a quick 30-min tech call.

sara.sales: confirmed — Prospect prefers artifacts only. i'll send the bundle with attestation Fri at 2pm and follow up with a questions list. thanks everyone.

mira.s: closing loop — upload final bundle link + attestation to the CRM ticket after send.
